title: XPRS
description: The stations heard over the air and the packets they sent.
summary: Every station this device has heard over Bluetooth or LAN or LoRa. The internet is never used. Browse the packets by kind and star the ones worth keeping. A starred packet keeps its own copy. Open any packet to read it field by field with an explanation of each field. The Carried tab shows the mail this device holds for stations that were out of range. You can stop carrying mail if you prefer.
